changelog:
- Initial release of markdown-converter.
- Added support for converting a wide range of file types (PDF, Office documents, HTML, CSV, images, audio, ZIP, YouTube, EPub) to Markdown.
- Provides guidance on usage, options, and examples in documentation.
- Added metadata file and removed old skill card file.
summary: Convert documents and files to Markdown using markitdown. Use when converting PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx, .xls), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, images (with EXIF/OCR), audio (with transcription), ZIP archives, YouTube URLs, or EPubs to Markdown format for LLM processing or text analysis.
